patch_description:
Introduce a mid-block RY layer and merge corner/edge pre/post RZ keys into shared keys to increase expressivity while reducing parameter duplication. Specifically:
- Merge rz_pre_corner/rz_post_corner into a single rz_corner and rz_pre_edge/rz_post_edge into rz_edge (center keys unchanged).
- Add a new mid-block RY layer before the CRX ring with new keys: ry_mid_corner, ry_mid_edge, ry_mid_center.
- Maintain existing ry_corner/ry_edge/ry_center for the initial RY layer and keep crx_ring and crz_hub_edge as shared per-block parameters.
- Post-entanglement RZ continues to share rz_corner/rz_edge for corners/edges and rz_post_center for the center.
This increases the parameter count per block to 12 (72 total), potentially improving expressivity and validation performance while preserving symmetry benefits. Ensure ANSATZ_SPEC reflects these new keys and ordering.
